**Top 5 Richest People in the United States (2022) – Undergraduate Alma Maters**

| Rank (2022) | Person | Approx. 2022 Net‑Worth* | Undergraduate University (or universities attended) |
|------------|--------|------------------------|------------------------------------------------------|
| 1 | **Elon Musk** | ≈ $219 billion | University of Pennsylvania – B.S. in Physics & B.S. in Economics (Wharton). *Also spent two years at Queen’s University (Kingston, Canada) before transferring.* |
| 2 | **Jeff Bezos** | ≈ $171 billion | Princeton University – B.S.E. in Electrical Engineering & Computer Science (1996). |
| 3 | **Bill Gates** | ≈ $129 billion | Harvard University – attended (entered 1973, left 1975). He did not graduate but his undergraduate studies were at Harvard. |
| 4 | **Warren Buffett** | ≈ $118 billion | University of Nebraska–Lincoln – B.S. in Business Administration (1950). |
| 5 | **Larry Ellison** | ≈ $107 billion | University of Illinois at Urbana‑Champaign – attended (1969‑1970). He later transferred to the University of Chicago but left without a degree. |

\*Net‑worth figures are rounded estimates from the **Forbes 2022 “World’s Billionaires” list** (the list that also ranks U.S. billionaires).  

**Notes**

* All five individuals were U.S. citizens (or held U.S. citizenship) during 2022.  
* Three of the five (Musk, Bezos, Buffett) earned formal undergraduate degrees; Gates, Ellison attended but did not graduate.  
* The universities listed are the institutions where they completed or primarily pursued their undergraduate education.
